title: He went cold. Now what?
hook: Coldness is a signal, not a verdict.
body_or_script: One cold reply does not define the whole connection. Look at timing, frequency, and what happens after conflict. Before you turn one message into a verdict, take the private Love Test and zoom out.
caption: He went cold, but panic does not need to lead. Pattern first. Private Love Test in bio.
